newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia 11 month tourism receipts $1.3 billion.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia 11 month tourism receipts $1.3 billion.

text.p: Tunisia's earnings from tourism, its main source of hard currency, were 1.3 billion dinars ($1.316 billion) in the first eleven months of 1996, up from 1.2 billion dinars in the same period last year, tourism ministry sources said on Monday.
The number of tourist arrivals was 3.4 million at the end of October, down from 3.6 million.
The number of tourists from European countries rose to 2.2 million from 2.1.
The number of visitors from Maghreb countries, mainly Algeria and Libya, fell by 23.6 percent to 1.1 million.
Earnings from tourism were 1.3 billion dinars in 1995, little changed from 1.3 billion dinars in 1994.
